nodes.description: External caller identity msg.sender, used for ownership, role and payout checks across Ownable, Withdrawable, PrizePool, CryptantCrabMarket and Transmuter.
block.timestamp accessed as now, used in auction timing, bid timestamps, withdrawal records and market pricing periods.
Withdrawable.withdraw(uint256 _amount): onlyWithdrawer guarded ether withdrawal that transfers balance to the stored withdrawer address.
PrizePool.claimPrize(bytes4 _prizeTitle): pays accumulated prize to msg.sender and then zeroes the winner entry.
CryptantCrabMarket.buyCrab(uint256 _marketId): payable purchase of an escrowed crab, pays seller, prize pool and settles market item state.
CryptantCrabMarket.purchase(uint256,uint256,address): payable mass crab purchase, mints tokens, credits cryptant, refunds excess ether, pays referral and prize pool.
CryptantCrabPurchasableLaunch._refundExceededValue(uint256,uint256): computes excess msg.value and transfers it back to msg.sender.
Randomable._generateRandom(bytes32 seed): keccak256 over blockhash(block.number-1) and seed, weak on-chain randomness source.
Randomable._generateRandomNumber(bytes32 seed, uint256 max): modulo reduction of _generateRandom output to a bounded number.
CryptantCrabMarketStore.addAuctionItem: pushes a new AuctionItem using now as startTime and stores endTime.
CryptantCrabMarketStore.addBidder: records a bid with now as bid time and updates the auction bid index array.
CryptantCrabMarketStore.addWithdrawal: appends a WithdrawalRecord using now as time and caller-supplied callTime.
CryptantCrabMarketStore.clearPendingWithdrawal: iterates withdrawal records, accumulates value and updates last withdrawn index.
Transmuter.xenograft(uint256,uint256,uint256): transplant a donor crab part into a recipient, generates fossil attributes and consumes cryptant.
Transmuter.mutate(uint256,uint256): mutates a crab part gene, generates legendary bonus, deducts cryptant and updates storage.
LevelCalculator.expRequiredToReachLevel(uint256 _level): loop-based experience requirement computation.
PrizePool.increasePrizePool(bytes4): payable external function that credits a prize pool, guarded by whitelist role.
Withdrawable.setWithdrawer(address): onlyOwner setter that changes the privileged withdrawer address.
Ownable._transferOwnership(address): internal ownership transfer that reassigns the owner state variable.
External ether send in Withdrawable.withdraw: withdrawer.transfer(_amount) executed before any state finalization.
External ether send in PrizePool.claimPrize: msg.sender.transfer(_claimableAmount) occurs before winner balance is zeroed.
External ether send in CryptantCrabMarket.buyCrab: marketItem.seller.transfer(_sellerAmount) to a caller-influenced address.
External ether send in CryptantCrabMarket.purchase: _referral.transfer(_referralReward) to a caller-supplied address.
External ether send in _refundExceededValue: msg.sender.transfer(_exceededValue) of surplus msg.value.
External call with value: prizePool.increasePrizePool.value(_prizePoolAmount)(currentPrizePool) invoked from purchase and buyCrab.
Randomness derived from blockhash(block.number-1), manipulable by miners and predictable on-chain.
Unchecked accumulation _withdrawnAmount += _withdrawalRecord.value in clearPendingWithdrawal.
Loop accumulation _expRequirement += 12 in expRequiredToReachLevel, plain uint256 arithmetic without SafeMath.
Ownable.owner: privileged address controlling setAddresses, setUint, setWithdrawer and reclaim functions.
Withdrawable.withdrawer: address allowed to pull ether from the contract.
mapping(bytes4 => uint256) internalUintVariable: configuration store for pricing, cuts, token id and cost keys.
CryptantCrabMarket.marketItems: array of MarketItem structs holding escrowed sales and seller payout addresses.
CryptantCrabMarket.tradedPrices: array of historical crab prices used for dynamic pricing.
PrizePool.prizePools: mapping of prize pool key to accumulated ether balance.
PrizePool.winners: mapping of address to prize title to claimable amount.
CryptantCrabMarketStore.withdrawalList: per-address array of pending WithdrawalRecord entries.
CryptantCrabMarket.prizePool: external PrizePool contract reference receiving value calls.
CryptantCrabBase.cryptantCrabStorage: external storage contract holding crab attributes.
Parameter _amount of Withdrawable.withdraw, bounds the ether amount transferred to the withdrawer.
Local _claimableAmount in PrizePool.claimPrize, cached winner prize used for the transfer.
Local int256 _partDiff in Transmuter.xenograft, difference between recipient and donor part genes.
Local _expRequired in Transmuter.mutate and xenograft, compared against accumulated experience.

edges.reason: withdraw is gated by onlyWithdrawer which compares msg.sender against the withdrawer state variable.
The _amount parameter flows into the withdraw amount checked against contract balance.
withdraw reads the privileged withdrawer state variable to determine the transfer destination.
withdraw performs an external ether transfer to the withdrawer address before returning.
claimPrize indexes the winners mapping using msg.sender as the claiming address.
claimPrize sends the claimable ether to msg.sender before zeroing the winner balance entry.
The cached _claimableAmount local variable is the value transferred out in claimPrize.
buyCrab uses msg.sender as the buyer and recipient of the escrowed token.
buyCrab forwards the seller proceeds with an external transfer to a stored seller address.
buyCrab performs an external value call into the prizePool contract.
buyCrab reads and mutates the marketItems array entry for the given market id.
buyCrab writes the last transaction period and price into internalUintVariable.
purchase uses msg.sender for minting, refunds and cryptant fragment crediting.
purchase delegates the surplus msg.value handling to _refundExceededValue.
purchase transfers the referral reward to a caller-supplied referral address.
purchase performs an external value call into the prizePool contract.
purchase pushes each single crab price into the tradedPrices array.
purchase updates CURRENT_TOKEN_ID, LAST_TRANSACTION_PERIOD and LAST_TRANSACTION_PRICE in internalUintVariable.
_refundExceededValue transfers the excess ether back to msg.sender.
_generateRandomNumber calls _generateRandom to obtain the underlying hash value.
_generateRandom consumes blockhash(block.number-1), a miner-influenceable timestamp-dependent entropy source.
addAuctionItem uses now as the auction start time, making behavior dependent on block timestamp.
addBidder records now as the bid time, making behavior dependent on block timestamp.
addWithdrawal stamps the withdrawal record with now, making behavior dependent on block timestamp.
clearPendingWithdrawal accumulates _withdrawnAmount with unchecked addition over withdrawal records.
clearPendingWithdrawal iterates and mutates the withdrawalList storage array.
xenograft calls _generateRandomNumber to determine the fossil attribute value.
xenograft computes _partDiff as an int256 subtraction reused for gene reconstruction.
mutate calls _generateRandomNumber to determine the legendary bonus value.
mutate caches the level exp requirement in the _expRequired local before comparison.
expRequiredToReachLevel accumulates _expRequirement in a loop without overflow protection.
increasePrizePool increments the prizePools mapping balance for the given prize pool key.
setWithdrawer reassigns the privileged withdrawer state variable.
_transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable controlling privileged functions.
_transferOwnership is reached only through onlyOwner guarded transferOwnership calls that check msg.sender.
setWithdrawer is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting changes to msg.sender equal to owner.
The cached _expRequired local is produced by the expRequiredToReachLevel computation.

normalization_plan.reason: The _amount parameter only exists to bound the ether amount sent by Withdrawable.withdraw and has no independent semantics.
_claimableAmount is a temporary cache of the winners mapping read inside claimPrize and is fully contained by it.
_partDiff is an int256 intermediate used only for the gene reconstruction arithmetic inside xenograft.
_expRequired is the direct result of expRequiredToReachLevel used for the level-up comparison in mutate and xenograft.
